children: NVIDIA (NVDA) agreed to buy Hugging Face for $12.93B on Sept 3, 2026. NVIDIA says Hugging Face stays open to broader AI community and will be integrated into NVIDIA’s software stack.
NVIDIA says OpenAI’s Astra (GPT‑6) trained on 100,000+ Grace Blackwell systems; another 400,000 GPUs planned. Signals massive NVDA hardware demand for large‑scale AI training.
NVIDIA says it’s teaming with major banks to mobilize over $500 billion in third‑party capital to finance AI infrastructure, targeting external funding for AI‑related infrastructure investments.
NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang says company compute infrastructure is a durable, revenue-driving asset and AI GPU demand remains strong; H100 rental rates reportedly rose about 22% to ~$3.28/hour.
NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang said AGI has arrived after OpenAI released GPT-6 Astra; critic Gary Marcus disputed the claim, arguing Astra doesn’t meet standard AGI criteria.
NVIDIA (NVDA) is eyeing data-center builds in South Korea, citing the country’s reliable power—an important factor for AI infrastructure and big computing needs.
